title: Smoking Weed Is A Sin‼️‼️
segments: In the renewing of our mind, we must
understand that smoking weed is a sin
according to the most high God. First
Peter's chapter 4 verse 7, it says to be
sober-minded.
Watch unto pray. We must be alert. We
cannot be alert with our minds altered
by drugs. First Corinthians chapter 3
verse 16 through 17, our body is the
temple of God. We cannot defile the
temple. That's where the sin comes in
that. We are defiling the temple of God
when we smoke weed. When we read Wisdom
of Solomon chapter 1 verse 5, we are the
temple of God. The Holy Spirit dwells in
us. But when we smoke, the Holy Spirit
did not deal with us. It flees when we
in the midst of sin. Wisdom of Solomon
chapter 16 verse 12, understand that
it's not herbs, it's not medicine that
heals us. It is the word of God. And
with that, I'll say shalom.
